method: Lane F3a (wave 4) ported XQuestResultXMLFile and XQuestResultXMLHandler (load, store, getters, splitByNth, splitByMiddle; the spec.xml writers are a named gap). ../oracle/F3a-xquest/driver.cpp, built on ibminode06 (never ibminode05) with the Release install's own conda g++ 14.4.0 against /ceph/ibmi/abi/oliver/opt/openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576, ran in fresh processes with a clean environment, twice, byte-identical (results/differ.txt empty, stored files compared with the date masked): load of the class-test fixture, 9 upstream TOPP xquest.xml files and 16 generated cases (every field of both out-parameters, doubles as %.17g, meta values with their DataValue type, and the three getters), store of each load, IdXMLFile::load + store of the 6 upstream XFDR idXML files, and 14 splitByNth/splitByMiddle calls. tests/xquest_result_xml.rs renders this port's load in the driver's format and compares it line by line; compares written files line by line with the date masked and the trailing meta-value attributes compared as a set (the source writes them in MetaInfoRegistry order); and compares each exception with the crate error kind documented for it. The six XFDR inputs over 700 kB are not retained; they passed the same tests in an ad-hoc run on dax.
